description: Hosts and nspawn services from telegraf metrics in VictoriaMetrics. Hosts and services are discovered from the data, nothing is hardcoded.

spec.description: One row per running service. Click a column header to sort.
spec.title: Services

spec.description: Percentage of all cores in use (100 − idle). The dashed line is time spent waiting on I/O.
spec.title: CPU busy

spec.description: Solid = used (excludes page cache), dashed = installed total. Both share one legend name, so one click toggles the pair.
spec.title: Memory used vs total

spec.description: Used % per mounted filesystem, excluding per-service volumes (see the Services row).
spec.title: Host filesystems

spec.description: Positive = read, negative = write. Both directions share one legend name and colour, so clicking a legend entry shows/hides both together. The legend has two rows per entry: the top row's stats are read, the bottom row's are write. Whole block devices only (partitions and LVM dm-* volumes are hidden).
spec.title: Disk I/O

spec.description: Positive = rx, negative = tx. Both directions share one legend name and colour, so clicking a legend entry shows/hides both together. The legend has two rows per entry: the top row's stats are rx, the bottom row's are tx. Host interfaces only; container veths are in the Services row.
spec.title: Network

spec.description: Drive temperatures from SMART and any lm_sensors chips telegraf finds on the host.
spec.title: Temperatures

spec.description: Hosts that reported system metrics in the last few minutes.
spec.title: Hosts

spec.description: CPU cores consumed by each service (from the container's cgroup cpu.stat).
spec.title: CPU

spec.description: Anonymous + shared memory as a percentage of each container's memory limit. Page cache is excluded; it is reclaimable and does not count as pressure.
spec.title: Memory used, % of limit

spec.description: Positive = rx, negative = tx. Both directions share one legend name and colour, so clicking a legend entry shows/hides both together. The legend has two rows per entry: the top row's stats are rx, the bottom row's are tx. Measured on each container's veth on the host.
spec.title: Network

spec.description: Used % of each per-service LVM volume mounted under /var/lib/volumes.
spec.title: Service volumes

spec.description: Anonymous + shared memory ("used"), total charged memory including page cache ("incl. cache"), and the container limit.
spec.title: Memory used vs limit

spec.description: Scheduler periods per second in which the service hit its CPUQuota. Non-zero means it wants more CPU than allowed.
spec.title: CPU throttling

spec.description: nspawn containers with a live cgroup on the selected hosts.
spec.title: Running services

spec.description: Busy time of the Intel iGPU engines: video (decode/encode), video enhance and render/3D.
spec.title: GPU engine utilization

spec.description: Actual Intel iGPU clock.
spec.title: GPU frequency

spec.description: Intel iGPU package power draw.
spec.title: GPU power

spec.description: Anonymous + shared memory of all service containers (page cache excluded).
spec.title: Service memory in use

spec.description: Sum of MemoryMax across running services. Compare with host memory: this is the worst case if every service hit its limit.
spec.title: Service memory limits

spec.description: Total CPU cores currently consumed by all services.
spec.title: Service CPU in use

title: Homelab
